items.title_cn: 基于机器学习的急性胰腺炎相关肝损伤早期预测模型的开发及单中心时间验证
items.title_en: Development and a single-centre temporal validation of a machine learning-based model for early prediction of acute pancreatitis-associated liver injury
items.abstract_cn: 急性胰腺炎（AP）是一种常见的急性腹部炎症性疾病，以胰酶过早激活为特征，导致胰腺自身消化、水肿、出血甚至坏死。肝脏作为接收胰腺静脉回流的第一站器官，是AP中最常受累的胰腺外器官之一。AP相关肝损伤（LI）与全身炎症强度、多器官功能障碍的发生及死亡率增加密切相关。尽管机器学习（ML）模型已成功应用于预测各种AP相关并发症，如急性呼吸窘迫综合征、急性肾损伤和感染性胰腺坏死，但在LI临床发作前进行早期预测的有效工具仍然缺乏。我们回顾性收集了2018年1月至2023年12月期间在河南科技大学第一附属医院诊断为AP的1，184例患者的数据。经过严格的纳入和排除标准筛选后，共纳入1，124例患者。开发队列由2018年1月至2022年12月期间入院的929例患者组成，按7：3比例随机分为训练集（n = 650）和内部测试集（n = 279）。独立的时间验证集由2023年1月至12月入院的195例患者组成。收集入院24小时内的49项临床和实验室参数，用于预测住院前24小时后发生的LI。入院24小时内任何ALT/AST升高> 3×ULN的患者不计为LI事件；结局严格定义为24小时后新发的LI。在训练集中，使用LASSO回归识别关键预测因素，随后构建了九种机器学习模型：逻辑回归（LR）、决策树（DT）、随机森林（RF）、XGBoost和LightGBM等。所有特征选择和超参数调优均仅在训练集上通过5折交叉验证进行嵌套，未使用测试集或验证集信息。模型性能主要采用受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）、校准指标（Brier评分、校准截距/斜率）和决策曲线分析（DCA）进行评估。采用SHAP方法对最优模型进行可解释性分析。LASSO回归识别出十个关键预测因素：淀粉酶（AMY）、脂肪酶（LIP）、总胆固醇（CHO）、白蛋白（ALB）、中性粒细胞百分比（N/W）、血清钙（Ca）、丙氨酸氨基转移酶（ALT）、性别、总胆红素（TBIL）和饮酒史。在九种模型中，随机森林（RF）模型表现出优越的预测性能和时间泛化能力，在内部测试集中AUC为0.972（95% CI：0.954–0.989），准确率为0.921；在时间验证集中AUC为0.935（95% CI：0.902–0.969），准确率为0.862。RF模型的训练-测试AUC差距为0.028（1.000 vs. 0.972），表明存在轻度过拟合。决策曲线分析证实了在多个阈值范围内具有净临床获益。SHAP分析显示，胰酶（AMY、LIP）和反映肝脏合成功能的标志物（ALB、CHO）是影响模型输出的主要预测因素。校准可接受，测试集和验证集的Brier评分分别为0.070和0.101；校准斜率分别为2.153（测试集）和1.367（验证集），表明预测概率存在过度离散（过度自信），在临床使用前需要进行事后重新校准。使用入院24小时内收集的常规临床数据构建的RF模型可以有效预测AP患者肝损伤的风险，并展现出良好的时间泛化能力。该模型为早期识别高危患者提供了一种潜在有用的工具；然而，在临床实施前需要进行前瞻性外部验证和概率重新校准。
items.abstract_en: Acute pancreatitis (AP) is a common acute abdominal inflammatory disorder characterized by premature activation of pancreatic enzymes, leading to pancreatic autodigestion, edema, hemorrhage, and even necrosis. The liver, as the first portal organ receiving pancreatic venous drainage, is one of the most frequently affected extra-pancreatic organs in AP. AP-associated liver injury (LI) is closely correlated with the intensity of systemic inflammation, the development of multiple organ dysfunction, and increased mortality. While machine learning (ML) models have been successfully applied to predict various AP-related complications such as acute respiratory distress syndrome, acute kidney injury, and infected pancreatic necrosis, effective tools for early prediction of LI before its clinical onset remain lacking. We retrospectively collected data from 1,184 patients diagnosed with AP at the First Affiliated Hospital of Henan University of Science and Technology between January 2018 and December 2023. After applying strict inclusion and exclusion criteria, 1,124 patients were included. The development cohort comprised 929 patients admitted between January 2018 and December 2022, randomly split into a training set (n = 650) and an internal test set (n = 279) in a 7:3 ratio. An independent temporal validation set consisted of 195 patients admitted from January to December 2023. Forty-nine clinical and laboratory parameters were collected within 24 h of admission to predict LI occurring after the first 24 h of hospitalization. Patients with any ALT/AST elevation > 3×ULN within the first 24 h were not counted as LI events; the outcome was strictly defined as incident LI emerging after 24 h. In the training set, LASSO regression was used to identify key predictive factors, followed by the construction of nine machine learning models: logistic regression (LR), decision trees (DT), random forests (RF), XGBoost, and LightGBM, among others. All feature selection and hyperparameter tuning were nested within 5-fold cross-validation on the training set only, with no use of test or validation set information. Model performance was primarily assessed using the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC), calibration metrics (Brier score, calibration intercept/slope), and decision-curve analysis (DCA). The SHAP method was employed for interpretability analysis of the optimal model. LASSO regression identified ten key predictors: amylase (AMY), lipase (LIP), total cholesterol (CHO), albumin (ALB), neutrophil percentage (N/W), serum calcium (Ca), alanine aminotransferase (ALT), gender, total bilirubin (TBIL), and drinking history. Among the nine models, the random forest (RF) model demonstrated superior predictive performance and temporal generalizability, achieving an AUC of 0.972 (95% CI: 0.954–0.989) with an accuracy of 0.921 in the internal test set, and an AUC of 0.935 (95% CI: 0.902–0.969) with an accuracy of 0.862 in the temporal validation set. The RF model showed a training–test AUC gap of 0.028 (1.000 vs. 0.972), indicating modest overfitting. Decision-curve analysis confirmed net clinical benefit across a range of thresholds. SHAP analysis revealed that pancreatic enzymes (AMY, LIP) and markers reflecting hepatic synthetic function (ALB, CHO) were the primary predictors influencing the model’s output. Calibration was acceptable, with Brier scores of 0.070 and 0.101 in the test and validation sets, respectively; calibration slopes were 2.153 (test) and 1.367 (validation), indicating over-dispersion of predicted probabilities (over-confidence) that would benefit from post-hoc recalibration before clinical use. An RF model built using routine clinical data collected within 24 h of admission can effectively predict the risk of liver injury in AP patients and demonstrates promising temporal generalizability. The model offers a potentially useful tool for early identification of high-risk patients; however, prospective external validation and probability recalibration are required before clinical implementation.

items.title_cn: IgG4相关病患者食管静脉曲张的内镜缓解：一例病例报告
items.title_en: Endoscopic resolution of esophageal varices in a patient with IgG4-related disease: a case report
items.abstract_cn: IgG4相关胰腺炎是一种复杂的多器官疾病，可模拟胰腺恶性肿瘤。糖皮质激素是一线治疗，但对于合并代谢性疾病（如糖尿病）的患者，其使用可能并非可选方案。我们报告一例罕见的58岁男性病例，表现为门静脉高压和食管静脉曲张。该患者因疑似胰腺恶性肿瘤接受了胰十二指肠切除术。然而，在修订过程中调取的手术病理报告证实为IgG4相关性自身免疫性胰腺炎，并记录了弥漫性硬化性淋巴浆细胞性炎症，伴有密集的导管周围淋巴浆细胞浸润、闭塞性静脉炎、纤维化/硬化以及IgG4阳性浆细胞增多（高达每高倍视野>50个）。血清IgG4记录为5,521 mg/dL。术后，患者出现胰岛素依赖性糖尿病，阻碍了糖皮质激素治疗。随后启动利妥昔单抗治疗，并在PET检查结果被解读为可能存在全身性受累后缩短了给药间隔。治疗后，记录的血清IgG4值逐步下降至17 mg/dL。2023年的随访内镜检查，配合配对的内镜图像，显示成像段内未见明显的食管静脉曲张。本病例描述了一种不寻常且具有临床相关性的时间关联。然而，现有数据尚不能确定门静脉高压已缓解，也不能确立利妥昔单抗与该内镜发现之间的因果关系。
items.abstract_en: IgG4-related pancreatitis is a complex and multiorgan disease that can mimic pancreatic malignancy. Corticosteroids are the first-line therapy, but their use may not be an option for patients with metabolic comorbidities, such as diabetes mellitus. We report a rare case of a 58-year-old man who presented with portal hypertension and esophageal varices. The patient underwent pancreaticoduodenectomy for suspected pancreatic malignancy. However, a surgical pathology report retrieved during revision confirmed IgG4-associated autoimmune pancreatitis and documented diffuse sclerosing lymphoplasmacytic inflammation with dense periductal lymphoplasmacytic infiltrates, obliterative phlebitis, fibrosis/sclerosis, and increased IgG4-positive plasma cells (up to >50 per high-power field). Serum IgG4 was recorded as 5,521 mg/dL. Postoperatively, the patient developed insulin-dependent diabetes mellitus, precluding corticosteroid therapy. Rituximab was initiated and the dosing interval was subsequently shortened after PET findings were interpreted as possible systemic involvement. Following treatment, recorded serum IgG4 values progressively decreased to 17 mg/dL. Follow-up endoscopy in 2023, supported by paired endoscopic images, demonstrated no visible esophageal varices in the imaged segment. This case describes an unusual and clinically relevant temporal association. However, the available data do not establish resolution of portal hypertension or a causal relationship between rituximab and the endoscopic finding.
items.summary_cn: 该病例报告描述了一名58岁男性因疑似胰腺恶性肿瘤行胰十二指肠切除术，术后病理确诊为IgG4相关性自身免疫性胰腺炎，因术后出现胰岛素依赖型糖尿病而无法使用皮质类固醇，改用利妥昔单抗治疗后血清IgG4从5,521 mg/dL降至17 mg/dL，2023年随访内镜显示成像节段未见食管静脉曲张。摘要指出该数据未确立门静脉高压的缓解或利妥昔单抗与内镜发现之间的因果关系。

items.title_cn: 间充质干细胞移植治疗重症急性胰腺炎相关肺损伤：动物研究的Meta分析
items.title_en: Mesenchymal stem cell transplantation for severe acute pancreatitis-associated lung injury: A meta-analysis of animal studies
items.abstract_cn:
背景
 本研究旨在评估间充质干细胞（MSCs）治疗急性呼吸窘迫综合征-急性肺损伤（ALI）的疗效，从而为未来临床使用干细胞治疗胰腺炎相关急性肺损伤提供循证参考。
 目的
 系统评价MSC移植治疗重症急性胰腺炎（SAP）-ALI的疗效。
 方法
 电子检索中国知网、万方数据、中国生物医学文献数据库、PubMed和Web of Science等数据库，检索自建库至2024年8月1日关于MSC移植治疗SAP-ALI的动物实验。由两名研究者独立检索文献、提取数据并评估各研究的偏倚风险。采用RevMan 5.4软件进行Meta分析。
 结果
 共纳入13项随机对照动物实验，涉及248只大鼠，其中MSC组124只，模型对照组124只。Meta分析表明，MSC移植降低了SAP大鼠胰腺组织和肺组织的组织病理学评分[标准化均数差（SMD）= -3.12，95%置信区间（CI）：-3.99至-2.25]。此外，MSC移植降低了肺湿干重比（加权均数差= -0.50，95%CI：-0.64至-0.36）、髓过氧化物酶活性（SMD = -3.29，95%CI：-4.40至-2.19）、肿瘤坏死因子-α（TNF-α）水平（SMD = -3.57，95%CI：-5.49至-1.64）及其mRNA表达（SMD = -3.74，95%CI：-5.27至-2.20）以及血清TNF-α水平（SMD = -3.51，95%CI：-4.51至-2.51）。与对照组相比，MSC组血清淀粉酶水平显著降低（SMD = -3.63，95%CI：-4.54至-2.72）。
 结论
 MSC移植可减轻SAP大鼠的肺部炎症反应并缓解SAP-ALI。然而，由于纳入研究数量和样本量有限，仍需进一步开展多中心、大规模随机对照试验以验证我们的发现。
items.abstract_en:
BACKGROUND
 This study is to evaluate the efficacy of mesenchymal stem cells (MSCs) in the treatment of acute respiratory distress syndrome-acute lung injury (ALI), so as to provide evidence-based reference for the clinical use of stem cells in the treatment of acute lung injury associated with pancreatitis in the future.
 AIM
 To systematically evaluate the efficacy of MSC transplantation in the treatment of severe acute pancreatitis (SAP)-ALI.
 METHODS
 Databases, including China National Knowledge Infrastructure, Wanfang Data, SinoMed, PubMed, and Web of Science, were electronically searched for animal experiments on MSC transplantation for SAP-ALI from inception of the databases to August 1, 2024. Two researchers independently retrieved the literature, extracted data, and assessed the risk of bias of individual studies. Meta-analysis was performed using the RevMan 5.4 software.
 RESULTS
 A total of 13 randomized controlled animal experiments were included, involving 248 rats, with 124 rats in the MSC group and 124 in the model control group. Meta-analysis indicated that MSC transplantation reduced the histopathological scores of pancreatic tissues and lung tissues [standardized mean difference (SMD) = -3.12, 95% confidence interval (CI): -3.99 to -2.25] in SAP rats. Additionally, MSC transplantation decreased lung wet-to-dry weight ratio (weighted mean difference = -0.50, 95%CI: -0.64 to -0.36), myeloperoxidase activity (SMD = -3.29, 95%CI: -4.40 to -2.19), and tumor necrosis factor-α (TNF-α) level (SMD = -3.57, 95%CI: -5.49 to -1.64) and its mRNA expression (SMD = -3.74, 95%CI: -5.27 to -2.20) as well as serum TNF-α levels (SMD = -3.51, 95%CI: -4.51 to -2.51). Compared with the control group, the MSC group had significantly lower serum amylase levels (SMD = -3.63, 95%CI: -4.54 to -2.72).
 CONCLUSION
 MSC transplantation can reduce the pulmonary inflammatory response and alleviate SAP-ALI in SAP rats. However, due to the limited number of included studies and sample size, further multicenter, large-scale randomized controlled trials are warranted to validate our findings.
items.summary_cn: 该Meta分析纳入13项动物实验（248只大鼠），发现间充质干细胞移植可降低SAP大鼠胰腺和肺组织的组织病理学评分，降低肺湿干重比、髓过氧化物酶活性及TNF-α水平，并降低血清淀粉酶水平，从而减轻SAP相关急性肺损伤的肺部炎症反应。

items.title_cn: 用于超快生物粘附和黏膜下注射的水凝胶
items.title_en: Hydrogels for ultrafast bio-adhesion and submucosal injection
items.abstract_en: Bio-adhesive hydrogels and lifting gels comprising sodium alginate and their use for preventing or controlling a gastrointestinal bleed or hemorrhage or sealing a perforation in tissue of a GI tract and separating diseased tissue from normal tissue in the GI tract, respectively, are disclosed. The hydrogel forms a calcium alginate barrier at the bleeding site, addressing the limitations of current endoscopic treatments for gastrointestinal bleeding which have limited efficacy, high recurrence of bleeding, and obscuration of the endoscopy view.
items.abstract_cn: 本发明公开了包含海藻酸钠的生物粘附水凝胶和抬举凝胶，分别用于预防或控制胃肠道出血或止血、封闭胃肠道组织穿孔，以及将病变组织与正常组织分离。该水凝胶在出血部位形成海藻酸钙屏障，解决了当前胃肠道出血内镜治疗疗效有限、再出血率高、以及内镜视野被血液遮挡的问题。同时可作为黏膜下注射抬举凝胶用于ESD术中组织分离。
items.summary_cn: 该专利由约翰斯·霍普金斯大学研发，提出一种基于海藻酸钠和CaCl₂的生物粘附水凝胶，在内镜下喷洒至出血部位后迅速形成海藻酸钙屏障实现止血。其核心创新在于兼具止血和黏膜下抬举双重功能：既能控制急性出血和迟发性出血，又能在ESD术中作为抬举凝胶分离病变组织与正常组织。优势在于减少多种内镜配件的使用需求，缩短操作时间，适用于难以精确定位的弥漫性出血和肿瘤出血场景。
items.assignee: JOHNS HOPKINS UNIVERSITY（美国约翰斯·霍普金斯大学）

items.title_cn: 用于机器人辅助手术的内镜多装夹施夹器
items.title_en: Endoscopic clip applier for robotic-assisted surgery
items.abstract_en: An endoscopic multi-load clip applier device includes a housing structured to include a compartment operable to store and distribute one or more clips; a flexible end coupled to the housing; and at least two grip components coupled to the housing and operable to compress and release upon control by robotic forceps of a robotic-assisted surgery system. The device enables multiple clip storage and automatic reloading, enhancing surgical efficiency and surgeon control in robotic-assisted surgery. The instrument can be introduced into an operative field via a bedside assistant port, and the surgeon can pick up the device using robotic forceps to place clips at the surgical site.
items.abstract_cn: 一���内镜多装夹施夹器装置，包括可存储和分发多个钛夹的壳体、连接于壳体的柔性端部、以及至少两个夹持组件。夹持组件可由机器人辅助手术系统的机械钳控制压缩和释放，使术者可在术中多次放置钛夹。该装置支持多夹存储和自动重装，提升机器人辅助手术中的效率和术者操控性。器械可通过床旁助手端口引入手术区域，术者使用机械钳夹取器械端部并在手术部位放置钛夹。
items.summary_cn: 该专利由加州大学研发，针对机器人辅助手术中血管结扎的痛点，设计了一种可存储多个钛夹并自动重装的内镜施夹器。核心创新在于将柔性端部设计与机器人机械钳操控相结合，术者可在不更换器械的情况下连续放置多个止血夹，大幅提升手术效率。该装置为一次性使用，成本低于现有技术，适用于机器人辅助的消化道手术中血管处理。
items.assignee: UNIVERSITY OF CALIFORNIA（美国加州大学）
